Fix settings page showing shadow branch as unhealthy when it is healthy
────────────────────────────────────────
ULID:      01KK4F08D3J3EQMKJ8YQN9T7NB
Type:      task
Status:    pending
Priority:  2
Automation: eligible

─── Description ───
  The settings page shows shadow branch status as 'Unhealthy' (yellow indicator) even when kspec shadow status reports it as healthy. The daemon endpoint GET /api/meta/shadow calls getShadowStatus() which checks branchExists, worktreeExists, and worktreeLinked. The UI shows unhealthy when enabled=true but healthy=false. Possible causes: (1) the daemon's initContext resolves a different project root than the CLI, (2) the project header is missing/wrong so the daemon checks the wrong directory, or (3) the getShadowStatus check fails for worktreeLinked in the daemon context.
Spec ref:  @ui-settings-view
Tags:      bug, web-ui
Created:   2026-03-07T15:35:06.403Z

─── Spec Context ───
Settings View
Type: feature
Implementation: implemented
Description:
  Web UI page for viewing project configuration, conventions, daemon connection info, and shadow branch status.
Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-1]
    Given: The user navigates to /settings
    When: The page renders
    Then: Displays project config (name, version, remote tracking), conventions list from meta, daemon connection info (port, uptime, version), and shadow branch status. Read-only for v1.
